transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for being here for our surge huddle. As we all know, we're currently running near usual capacity with 10 of our 12 treatment spaces occupied. We're also monitoring a regional increase in pediatric respiratory illness, and we expect ED demand to be higher tomorrow. The good news is we have an unused observation wing with eight bays available for temporary clinical use starting tomorrow. I have the authority to activate it, but I want to hear from all of you before we finalize the operating plan. Let's talk through what we need from facilities, nursing staffing, and bed management to make this work. Who wants to start?
